notes.title: OLT v.1.5
notes.content:
[p]Given some user's feedback in this version I introduced some new settings:[/p][list][*][p]Invert axis option (horizontal and vertical) for both gamepad and mouse[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603009/18b7fb51925f798488c573df163c11e9920cfb51.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Experimental input mapping [b](only for keyboard and mouse)

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603009/c693b8030141d0b725348ba90709d0bdda66fb95.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]In the meantime One Last Toast got enough reviews to get the summary score next to the title. Which is a great milestone for this project! A big big [b]Thank You[/b] to everyone who took a moment to leave a review. It means the world to me.[/p][p] I am currently planning the next update where I'd like to introduce some little extra content. Keep an eye on this page. 🍷[/p]

notes.title: OLT v.1.4
notes.content: [p]In this version I addressed some bugs that might cause a soft lock and I tweaked other minor things.[/p][p][/p][h2]Gameplay[/h2][list][*][p]Reduced pain/stun chance for Bepi[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced ammo spawn chance of exploding enemies[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Remove Washing Machine with Shotgun Ammo in Basement. You could get soft locked if you used all existing Detergents on this one, before you could get the key. I also removed extra detergents/softener items around the map leaving only the ones that are actually needed to progress. I hope this makes the puzzle clearer[/p][/*][*][p]Ensure chest in Attic always has a loot[/p][/*][*][p]Removed floating gun collectible in Main Hall[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: OLT v1.3
notes.content: [p]I have had the chance to look at footage of someone playing the game on Youtube! While delighted, I noticed a series of things I didn't really like.[/p][p]So, here's a small update.[/p][p][/p][h2]Gameplay[/h2][list][*][p]Zombie drop probability reduced to ~1%. They only drop pistol ammo and by the end of the game you will end with too much.[/p][/*][*][p]Repositioned shield-giver minions during final fight. Some were way too hard to hit.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Kitchen elevator now allows you to dismount when taken to go up. It used to get stuck, locking you in the basement area until further progress was made.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed studio map floor showing an area bigger than the actual room when highlighted on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Allow to use up 6 keyboard shortcuts - 1 for each equippable weapon (it was limited to 3, causing some confusion when you'd collect more than 3).[/p][/*][/list][h2]Various[/h2][list][*][p]Added the Vault to the map. Used to be a generic "Storage".[/p][/*][/list][p]Until the next time![/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - OLT v1.2
notes.content: [p]I am releasing this hotfix mainly to address a game-crashing bug reported by Shiba (many thanks for reporting this). [/p][p]Since I was at it, I cleaned and polished a few more things.[/p][p]Below is the list of all the changes.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Added a guard to prevent Pig Bepi from crashing the game when de-spawning under certain conditions[/p][/*][*][p]Clean up bomb fields (an intended effect of exploding molotovs) after a few seconds, to prevent them from accumulating indefinitely[/p][/*][*][p]Allow molotovs to actually scare Pig Bepi away like other weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collision setup that would allow molotovs to damage enemies behind certain walls[/p][/*][*][p]Prevent player from dying if it gets hit after a boss is defeated[/p][/*][/list][h2]Cosmetic changes[/h2][list][*][p]Ensure that player weapon is invisible in cutscene that didn't hide it correctly[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your reports, they help me deliver a better experience for everyone![/p]

notes.title: OLT v1.1
notes.content: [p]I am updating the game to v1.1 adding support for the Demo version and the following list of changes:[/p][p][/p][h3]Bugs:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused boss music to overlap ambient music[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a glitch in the outdoor area where giant vines and any geometry rendering in front of the skybox would have "jagged" outlines[/p][/*][/list][h3]Cosmetic Changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Additional set dressing in various rooms[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: One Last Toast Is Out!
notes.content: [h1]One Last Toast is Out![/h1][p][b]Bepi's Mansion has opened its doors to the public…[/b][/p][p]Whoever dares to attend the party is in for a short but intense adventure, one that brings back the classic survival horror vibes of the ’90s. Expect zombies, monsters, puzzles, and weird contraptions inside a sprawling mansion where everything went horribly wrong after Bepi's latest wine presentation.[/p][p]This is my first commercial release, and I sincerely hope it offers you a few hours of classic entertainment.[/p][p][b]See you inside. 🕯️[/b][/p]
